name: What types of interior doors are available for replacement?

mainEntity.name: What types of interior doors are available for replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: There are several types of interior doors to consider for replacement, each with different features and aesthetics. Common options include hollow-core doors, which are lightweight and economical; solid-core doors, offering better sound insulation and durability; and solid wood doors, known for their strength, aesthetic appeal, and natural sound-ddampening properties. Other options include French doors, barn doors, and bifold doors, which offer unique functional and design benefits. Your choice often depends on factors like budget, desired soundproofing, privacy needs, and the overall style of your home. Consider how each door type contributes to the room's function and aesthetic.
acceptedAnswer.description: Interior doors include hollow-core, solid-core, solid wood, French, barn, and bifold, each offering distinct benefits in terms of cost, durability, and style.
